title: agent-safety-audit — audit agent permissions and scan transcripts for destructive or escape patterns
description: Use this skill when an opencode agent prompts for permission on every command, when a dispatched subagent fails with a permission error, or when you need to audit and repair an agent's permission.bash map — and when an agent damaged something, when auditing a dispatch wave, or before trusting a fleet of background subagents. Ships two scanners: scripts/opencode-permission-scan.py mines the opencode log and session DB for every permission ask, with a per-agent bash-map verdict and a drop-in corrected permission block; scripts/agent-transcript-scan.py scans agent transcripts (Claude Code .jsonl and opencode's SQLite store) for destructive and escape-the-project patterns (rules R1–R9, including the cross-agent redirect-through-a-symlink chain R7). Includes the opencode inspection cheatsheet and the rules of permission resolution (merge order, last-match-wins, agent-map shadowing, atomic bash calls, non-interactive ask auto-reject).
author: sox-ecosystem

agent.description: Agent id to audit (e.g. git-manager). Omit to audit every installed agent.

out_path.description: Path for the full report. Defaults to a temp file named opencode-perms-<agent>-*.txt.

agents_dir.description: Directory of installed agent .md files. Defaults to ~/.config/opencode/agents.

permission_prompts.description: Number of permission prompts attributed to the agent.

verdict.description: Section 7 verdict for the agent's bash map (e.g. DEFECT / ok).
